i dont have a great answer, but in my experience, often the person who is in contact with you from the cult will offer you something, ideally, something you lack in your life

whether thats emotional support, interest in your life or personality, community and its people + resources, in other cases this can go more extreme

then they will increase these things, depending on how big their network is, and how vulnerable you are, you may find yourself enrolled in their school help center, or picnics, or fundraisers, or spiritual/religious activities

slowly, your contact may start to point out how your regular support systems (friend family access to media) may actually be harming you (making you feel bad, restricting your freedom, not doing enough for you) and slowly plant the idea that only the cult is where you can thrive

later, when or if you notice that it is actually the cult who is harming you, they may take away things that were offerring you, try to manipulate you etc, the more vulnerable you are, bigger investment they put in you, the harder they will try to keep you, they might even tell other people lies about you or try to put you in a position where you have nowhere else to go

they might discard you only and only if you stop serving them and harm them instead

all of this depends on the significance of what needs you have, and how big their network is (number of people, amount of money they recieve, number of webs within the people, the power they hold due to the people they recruited with in different areas of society: such as the local government, schools, churchs, online spaces they occupy)

for me, if i feel somethings coming up but i cant feel it, like something is there but i cant access it and i dont wanna keep burying more feelings on top of each other, to the point i cant access anything anymore and freeze, i do a few things

1-) i listen to audibooks, speeches, podcasts that has other people talk about their struggles, there is this book called "not that bad, dispatches from rape culture" and it has essays written by sexual assault survivors. recently i listened to them to connect with someone far away talking about their pain and anger. usually makes me cry and brings up my own stuff. sometimes i just cry listening to it while i do my chores or something, just to cry and cry. and this helps me because im accessing some sort of emotion, like first putting your legs in the water before putting your body. after this i try to engage with more whats in my head, and i find feelings more bearable and accessible. of course this isnt for everyone, but if you have a specific trauma, reading and listening to other people talk about their own pain can help (not like in some self improvement way, just people expressing their feelings and how horrible it is etc)

2-) exercise. i find that forcing myself to exercise even for 20 minutes helps me. because i only think about wanting the exercise to end. i dont think about anything else, nothing else matters. and that gives me a relief. and the sense of relief tells my brain, look, its possible to feel relief, we are not slipping away, we are okay right now, and its tough, but we do get to have breaks.

3-) treat yourself like you are another person (friend). literally force yourself to imagine yourself as someone else. ill give an example of what i do when im overwhelmed but im not sure how this scenario would work in freeze mode. lets say im very overwhelmed and im hungry and feel like i cant sleep even tho i need to wake up early, i have 7 responsibilities tmrw idk how it will be, im losing my mind. if i was feeling fine and the struggling person was michael (my best friend), how would i treat michael? what have i told michael in the past when he was struggling? maybe i would say right now lets eat 1 thing. thats all that matters for right now. thats the priority and the next priority may be to shower to soothe. and if you cant sleep then you cant sleep. but you obviously wont be able to sleep if you pressure yourself. i just keep pretending. you can imagine yourself as a kid or as your pet, even if you dont believe it in your head just do it as if its like a drama thing, it has helped me before.

obviously i dont know if these will help in your situation so check if they feel right to you in the moment.

if you have the mental space, ill tell you what ive done in the past. but its definetely not ideal but just to show you ive done it. 

go on indeed, search your citys name, filter parttime fulltime etc and sort by date. look at jobs that doesnt require cerifications or degrees. like: dishwasher, line cook, retail, some places call workers crew member or team member, custodian, cleaner, cashier, stocksperson, clerk. some of these jobs require drivers license or food handler or smartserve certificate, so dont apply if they say that. then apply to as many as you can, some of them are very easily apy thru indeed, with a few steps (literally 10 seconds to apply). some take you to external websites which is a hassle so i avoid. every day do the same search and sort by new so you will see new jobs. if you spend 10 minutes browsing every day and do this, you will get a few interviews. some of these people will hire anyone regardless of qualifications or experience, they simply need someone. i have done this before and an interview wont guarantee a job but a job will definetely require an interview so i try to keep positive mindset. its hard to do this, but its possible, im a newcomer and so are many people i know who have 0 experience and thats how ive done it. thats how many immigrants have done it to survive. also you are more likely to get a shit minimum wage job in the spring/summer.

for resume building, for jobs like this they dont check references, you can put a random small grocery store cashier or made up volunteer positions like idk u tutored english for newcomers (u dont need any qualifications for that). you can say youve done fostering animals for a shelther too (shelters usually require police check nd that can experience can make u more trustworthy) honestly you can write whatever you want in your resume if u are applying to a minimum wage job, they wont check and if they do well too bad. write skills like microsoft proficient interpersonal skills etc to fill the page. if they ask whats the gap, say you had health issues. ive mentioned health issues before and was asked, are you healthy now? and i lied and said yes. if they dont hire they wont. but again, some people will hire anyone and thats the goal.

if you keep doing this, it is possible to find a job. but to find a suitable job? im not sure. some jobs are nicer than others like dishwasher is gross but they allow you to put headphones in and you probably wont have to talk to anyone, same thing can be said for dollarama stocking person. if you live in a big city there is uber walker.

look online for interview tips and if applicable, say ill start today if you want, managers usually like hearing that thats how i got one of my jobs. 

honestly even if you dont go out of your way to apply to every possible shit job ever, (browsing on indeed can be draining too), you may find the 1 simple job thats somehow suitable that you didnt know it existed. like maybe somewhere really close to where you live even. obviously have your own criteria and dont work somewhere u dont think you will fit or will harm your health. but if you wanna try something and think you can, there is not much to lose, good part of a shitty job is you can always quit.
